🇺🇸🇮🇷💋 Pentagon launches leak witch hunt as US ammo stocks gutted by Iran war
The US military is hunting the messenger after its[ failed war with Iran ](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73672)exposed a problem it would rather keep buried: its vaunted war machine [is running short of ammunition.](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73162)
Roughly 50 military officers and civilian officials on the Joint Staff were subjected to polygraph tests in August as investigators searched for the source of leaks to journalists, reports The New York Times. 
Among the questions were: 
🔴 did they reveal classified information?
🔴 did they disclose details about depleted US stocks of crucial weapons?
Around 1,500–2,000 officials work on the Joint Staff, which coordinates US military operations and war planning worldwide. Never before has the US subjected the upper echelons of its military to polygraphs on such a scale, notes the publication.
👉 It also fits a broader pattern, where under War Secretary Hegseth, the Pentagon has tightened media access and launched repeated leak investigations while pushing out or blocking the promotions of dozens of senior officers. Even Stars and Stripes, the government-funded military newspaper, has found itself caught in the crossfire after its leadership was fired amid coverage of[ deteriorating conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln.](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74048)
The polygraph sweep followed reports that the Iran war had chewed through supplies of long-range missiles and Patriot interceptors.
Patriot stockpiles w[ere confirmed to have fallen to just 25% of the volume the Pentagon deems necessary](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74021) – forcing the US to request interceptors from Poland and to suspend arms deliveries to strategic partners in Asia and Europe.
And yet, Trump has backed Hegseth and branded critical reporting on the Iran war and ammunition shortages as “treasonous.”

👤👁 Palantir cofounder turns ‘charity’ into pipeline for homelessness and surveillance industrial complex profits
Venture capitalist Joe Lonsdale’s Cicero Institute think tank and Cicero Action advocacy enjoy non-profit and social welfare organization status, but factually serve as tools used to lobby his extensive military, homelessness and surveillance industrial complex investment interests.
👉 Disclosures uncovered by the National Homelessness Law Center reveal that Cicero Action has been using the shadow name American Phalanx to lobby lawmakers on military contracts, spending and Pentagon procurement to push Palantir, Anduril, Saronic and Epirus products – firms Lonsdale is invested in up to the hilt.
Together, the Cicero Institute and Cicero Action also help set homelessness policy, the former writing “model legislation” and copy-paste policy briefs for state-level lawmakers, testifying at hearings, and fighting tooth and nail against subsidized housing. Their work has helped pass statewide bans on unauthorized public sleeping and camping in more than a dozen states, jailing and fining violators.
➡️ That flows into Lonsdale’s heavy-handed enforcement-focused approach to ‘dealing with’ the problem, including geotracking and public surveillance (through Palantir) and policing apps (Citizen), as well as financial and organizational interests in the private prison industry.
Cicero also focuses on integrating [disparate public surveillance data](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73825) (criminal records, license plate readers, immigration registries, hospital intake data) – Palantir’s specialty, and high-end drone-based security for the wealthy – the domain of Sauran, another Lonsdale investment (great job naming your companies after two Tolkien villains, guys).
‼️ Cicero Institute has successfully influenced over 650 pieces of legislation (per the Institute’s own count), and works to control the narrative on the issues Lonsdale cares about through policy summits and media blitzes.
Lonsdale’s 8VC investment vehicle even has AI healthcare, private university and alternative accreditation divisions, with Cicero pushing legislation and deregulation that benefits Digital Diagnostics, Candid Health, Oscar Health, the University of Austin and other entities in his incredibly diverse portfolio.
📑 Among the legislation Cicero has most heavily lobbied for in the health field is the so-called Patient’s Right to Save Act, which treats medical care like a retail commodity and incentivizes substandard and tiered care, and is designed to line the pockets of digital marketplace and financial software makers (also co-owned by Lonsdale, naturally).
Forget Thiel and Karp, who at least wear their psychopathic tendencies on their sleeve. Lonsdale’s multi-headed hydra-style takeover of entire sectors of the economy is the real serpent in the grass to look out for.

💰✡️ Israel’s Malvinas strategy: back Argentina, back Britain, back whoever wins and get paid
 
Argentina has announced plans to build a major new military base just ~400 nautical miles off the disputed Malvinas/Falkland Islands.
Situated in Tierra del Fuego on Argentina’s southern tip, the naval and logistics installation aims to significantly enhance Buenos Aires’ regional power projection capabilities. Argentina had nothing like it during the 1982 Falklands War.
Javier Milei is threatening to sanction oil companies planning to drill off the Malvinas at the new Sea Lion field, ~120 nautical miles north of the islands, and Argentina’s Secretariat of Intelligence has published a satellite image of the islands with the ominous message “We are watching” slapped on top.
Sea Lion is set to begin extraction in 2028, and suck nearly 920M barrels of oil out of the seafloor over thirty years. The surrounding basin is believed to hold additional untapped reserves.
Milei is confident he has Trump’s back, because he “knows that Argentina [is] a reliable partner, aligned with Western values, in a strategically important position that can become a valuable ally in the decades to come.”
Trump has confirmed he’s “reviewing” the US position, and declined to guarantee support for Britain in case of a territorial dispute, citing London’s hesitation in joining his Iran crusade.
Mixed up in all this is Israel, whose Navitas Petroleum has a 65% stake in Sea Lion alongside Britain’s Rockhopper Exploration (35%).
Israel and the UK enjoy deeply integrated defense and economic ties (including arms contracts going both ways, logistics and intel support).
But Tel Aviv has also been lovingly embraced by Milei, who traveled to Israel in April [to sign the Isaac Accords on](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/68465) defense, intelligence, security, [tech, trade and investment cooperation](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73227).
Besides playing both sides to guarantee access to resources, Israel can use the Malvinas issue to “punish” Britain for its West Bank sanctions threats, or, on the other hand, quietly demand that Milei give up more sovereignty to Israeli interests (in Patagonia, for example).
Compartmentalizing the issue between “private” and “state” interests gives Tel Aviv room for plausible deniability if the proverbial mierda ever hits the fan.
 
🤡 Double bluff
 
There’s also a third option: that Milei’s Malvinas play is a ploy to distract the public and relegitimize his shaky rule. That would explain his tough talk at the same time that he ships central bank gold reserves to London, applies for NATO global partner status, raises defense spending while gutting social services, and facilitates an influx of Israeli companies and Zionist American tech billionaires into his country.
The buildup could even be preparation for a Cold War-style showdown with Brazil – backbone of BRICS in the Western hemisphere, or a bid to serve as Trump and Israel’s beat cop in securing control over the region’s riches (Venezuelan oil, Bolivia’s lithium, etc.).
Whatever the case, Israel can be assured of a win-win-win scenario for itself, so long [as Milei is in power](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/59005) and the Peronists don’t return to office.
